title: ClickFix Assistant
subtitle: Answers questions and sets things up with you
welcome_body: I know the page you're on. Ask how something works or let's set things up together; nothing I suggest is applied until you confirm.
starters.invite: I want to invite a teammate
starters.problem: I want to report a problem
escalate.hint: The chat is sent to the ClickFix support team so a specialist can take over. The reply reaches your email.

errors.ai_unavailable: AI is not available right now, try again shortly.
errors.support_unavailable: Hand-over to support is not configured yet.

platform.title: ClickFix Assistant
platform.description: Every organization's in-page AI assistant. It runs on the platform's AI key and is never charged to the organization's credits.
platform.enabled_hint: When off, no organization can use the assistant.
platform.model_route_hint: One of the existing AI task routes (AI_<TASK>_* environment).
platform.daily_limit_hint: 0 stops the assistant for every organization.
platform.support_org_hint: “Talk to support” requests open as conversations in this organization's API, widget or email inbox.
platform.prompt_extra_hint: Added to every chat (e.g. current announcements, known issues). At most 4000 characters.
platform.usage_hint: Assistant usage is not deducted from organizations' AI credits; the cost is the platform's.
action.open_and_show: Open the page and show me
action.not_verified: Applied but could not be verified
